name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.5.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Adds bounded exact independent closure arithmetic from raw edges, nine operator-directed synthetic SQL fixture families with optional independent gold and replay, and opt-in configured OWL definition witnesses checked against independent expected memberships. Synthetic agreement does not prove real-data V4 coverage or business correctness; source empty-class not_proven remains. Existing version 1 configurations and dependency pins remain supported. Rerun the pipeline after upgrading; no shared MVCC snapshot across Cube or stages or runtime attestation is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
